task_summary: Honest opportunity/risk assessment of an operator-shared alpha-stage crypto bot/signal marketplace platform (Bybit/AEX/Pionex connectors, drag-and-drop optimizer, marketplace revenue-share). Verdict — the platform's "auto-optimize + stress-test + robustness badge" is the same selection-bias trap NovaCore has repeatedly killed (DSR 0.957 → negative on sealed OOS); crypto is a legitimate alpha pivot but the platform's validation is marketing, not methodology; HIGH security risk on API-key custody
